meta.title: About Us — Amadewi Trans
meta.description: A family transport service from Batubulan, Bali — who we are and how we drive.

about.title: A family business <gold>from Batubulan.</gold>
about.text: We started with one car and a promise to drive guests the way we'd drive our own family. That promise is still the whole business plan.
story: Amadewi Trans began in Batubulan, the stone-carving village on the road between the airport and Ubud.
Our drivers are neighbours, not contractors. They know the back roads that skip the traffic, the warung worth stopping at and when a temple is quiet enough to enjoy.
Every booking is answered by a real person, every car is cleaned before every trip, and the price we quote is the price you pay — fuel, parking and the driver included.

meta.title: Contact — Amadewi Trans
meta.description: Book a private car and driver in Bali. WhatsApp us any hour — a real person replies.

contact.title: Tell us where <gold>you're headed.</gold>
contact.text: Send your dates and pick-up point. A real person in Batubulan replies — usually within minutes, any hour of the day.
